sample: one midpoint frame per pre-subtitle scene clip for BOTH V1 and V2
v1_source: retained V1 scenes/<scene_id>.mp4 before VideoAssembler subtitle burn-in
v2_source: V2 rendered scene clips before final audio mux
aggregate: 100 * weighted mean across all 9 representative scene frames
interpretation: deterministic static-composition proxy only; not a human aesthetic score
